Name: Valentine's Poke Plushie Catalogue
Author: LashelleValentine
Description:
[size=4][b]Description
[/b][/size]
[color=#D4D4D8]Bring a little Poké plushie magic to your Stardew Valley farm!
The Poké Plushie Catalogue adds a collection of 71 Pokémon plushies, featuring remastered pixel artwork and three different size categories.[/color]

Inspired by [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/2261]this[/url] mod, but I wanted even more Poke Plushies!!!

[size=4][b]Installation instructions[/b][/size]
[list=1]
[*][color=#D4D4D8]Install [url=https://smapi.io/]SMAPI[/url].[/color][/*]
[*][color=#D4D4D8]Download and unzip this mod.[/color][/*]
[*][color=#D4D4D8]Place the [/color]

[code]PokemonDollCatalogue[/code][color=#D4D4D8]folder inside your Stardew Valley [/color]

[code]Mods[/code][color=#D4D4D8]folder.[/color][/*]
[*][color=#D4D4D8]Launch the game through SMAPI.[/color][/*]
[*][color=#D4D4D8]Visit Pierre's General Store to purchase your catalogue![/color][/*]
[/list]

[size=4][b]Main features[/b][/size]
[list]
[*][color=#D4D4D8]71 collectible Pokémon plushies.[/color][/*]
[*][color=#D4D4D8]Small, medium, and large plushies.[/color][/*]
[*][color=#D4D4D8]Classic-style plushie variants.[/color][/*]
[*][color=#D4D4D8]An in-game catalogue where you can browse and purchase the collection.[/color][/*]
[*][color=#D4D4D8]Available from Pierre's General Store.[/color][/*]
[/list]

[size=4][b]Requirements[/b][/size]
[size=3][color=#D4D4D8]Requires SMAPI[/color][/size]
